_arguments: `arguments` is the single declaration of a tool's argument names.
`model` must equal the TypeBox property names in node_app/src/main.mjs;
a contract test fails the build when they drift.
`host` are keys only the host may inject, never exposed to the model.
webserver/pi_copilot/tools.py reads this; it declares nothing itself.
`model_schema` is null when main.mjs declares the tool's TypeBox schema.
Otherwise it is the schema the host generates from its own models
(see test_pi_copilot_tool_catalog.py), and main.mjs reads it from here.

oneOf.description:
Each concept's status is present within the window: no threshold.

An inclusion keeps the stays with every concept present; an exclusion
removes the stays with its one concept present.  A stay is removed when
it meets any exclusion, so an exclusion cannot name a combination.  With
no window, the status counts over the whole stay.

strategies.description:
The reader labels of the two strategies, whose kinds are fixed.

One strategy starts the treatment within the grace period; the other does
not start it within that period and leaves it unrestricted afterwards.
strategies.title: TrialStrategies

time_zero.description: The hour after ICU admission at which eligibility and follow-up start.
time_zero.title: TrialTimeZero

treatment.description:
The treatment whose start the strategies time.

``concepts`` are event-status concepts read together: the treatment
starts at the first hour any of them is recorded.  ``treatment_class``
names the class of drug the study means, from the capture registry's
closed vocabulary, so the host can tell whether the concepts record every
drug of that class.
treatment.title: TrialTreatment
